reviews.name: Isabelle Adler
reviews.text: The best ever, seriously!!! I have done multiple trips with SYB and the most recent was fantastic as ever. We had a great time in the Dolomites - hikes were challenging but doable. Then, Lake Garda was fabulous and so refreshing. Thank you to the leaders for doing a great job!

reviews.name: Fahim Falzada
reviews.text: I did the Iceland (fire & ice) trip with some of the most amazing people around. The trip was fantastic and the itinerary was full of surprises. From incredible hikes in the mountains to chasing waterfalls and relaxing in hot springs, there is nothing else like it. It is truly a blessing to have professionals plan the entire trip, so that I could turn off my mind and simply enjoy being present. I was in good company with the leaders, who organized and worked hard around the clock to make sure we all had an excellent experience. It takes a lot of work and skill to run these trips and the leaders at SYB are absolute pros who are dedicated to the craft. Look no further; this is it. You will remember your experience forever and might get hooked to go again and again. Thank you SYB for making the world a better place!

reviews.name: Samantha Donovan
reviews.text: What an absolutely amazing trip!!! I just returned from Iceland and it was a trip of a lifetime. We were spoiled with the sunshine, rainbows, hikes, workouts, puffins, northern lights and most important the best people. Eli, Christian and Meag as leaders made the experience even better. Each day they were hyping us up for our adventure, leading the way, capturing the most beautiful photos. Highly recommend the three of them as your next leaders! Thanks SYB - can’t wait for the next trip!

reviews.name: Sierra Vigna
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Travelled for a third time with SYB to Iceland and it was the best decision I ever made. My favourite thing about these trips is that I book it and don't have to think twice about itinerary or planning for a second - I just show up and SYB shows me the time of my life. Meag, Christian and Eli - the amazing leaders who show up for everyone and really are the glue that holds the whole thing together - thank you SO MUCH for all of your effort and for being incredible humans and guiding us through this unbelievable trip. I'll probably have to edit this review again in a few months because I'm not done travelling with SYB!

Just came back from my second trip with SYB - the Nicaragua trip was incredibly fun and I felt zero stress the entire time I was there. Holly, Matas and Luke were the coolest leaders and kept everything organized while also having a blast alongside our group. 10/10 recommend traveling this way - good for the soul. 🩷

reviews.name: Ryan Pitts
reviews.text:
My SYB Iceland trip was an absolutely unforgettable experience! From start to finish, the trip was filled with great vibes, amazing people, and incredible experiences.

A huge shoutout to our leaders Meag, Christian, and Eli for making the trip so special. They brought such great energy, made everyone feel included, and did an awesome job keeping the group connected and having fun. You could tell they genuinely cared about everyone having a great experience.

The itinerary was incredible — we got to see some of the most beautiful landscapes Iceland has to offer, experience the Northern Lights, take amazing photos, do a cold plunge, and somehow even fit in fun and games, trampolines, and plenty of laughs along the way. There was always something going on, but it never felt overwhelming.

The combination of the scenery, adventures, people, and overall atmosphere made this trip something I’ll remember for a long time. I came home with some incredible photos and even better memories.

10/10 would do it again. If you’re thinking about booking an SYB trip, do it!

reviews.name: Bart Fuchs
reviews.text: Best group travel around. If you want to not worry about where to go while traveling join this amazing group. My trip to Iceland would not have been half as fun and rewarding if not for these amazing people leading the way and taking us to the best hiking spots and hot springs in record time. If you want to travel and get stuff done in a short amount of time while making incredible friends along the way, it’s worth the money. Take the leap!!

reviews.name: Amber S.
reviews.text:
Just completed my 1st SYB trip in Iceland, and it'll be a tough one to beat! I’ve traveled solo and abroad with friends, but this was my first time joining group travel. I wasn’t totally sure what to expect going in, but the experience exceeded my expectations. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming, and I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better group.

Our leaders, Meag, Christian, and Eli, were the perfect mix of fun, energetic, and encouraging. They kept us motivated, grounded when needed, and laughing throughout the trip.

We somehow managed to get incredible weather all week! The hikes were challenging, the views were UNREAL, and we even got a little Northern Lights action. I came home with a shorter bucket list, and made some unforgettable memories along the way.

The accommodations were clean, comfortable, convenient, and the whole trip was well organized.

I’d absolutely recommend SYB to anyone looking to see the world, push themselves a little, and connect with some awesome people along the way. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure and hope to maybe run into some familiar faces!

reviews.name: Kelsey Rudzinsky
reviews.text:
I just got back from my first SYB trip, I went to Iceland. Truly, a 10/10 trip. This company is the real deal. I felt safe, supported, and excited for more the entire week. Eli was the trip leader and he is one of the most wonderful humans I have met! Eli, Meag, and Christian were the perfect balance and it was clear they put so much energy and intention into making the entire week as incredible as it was.

As someone who doesn’t really drink, I was nervous going in that I’d feel left out. I didn’t. The people who go on these trips are definitely the work hard, play hard type- but they are welcoming and accepting of all. The physicality of the trip exceeded my expectations. I felt pushed and challenged by the hikes. The accommodations were clean and safe- and it was really fun to share a room with 6 people- it felt like being at summer camp.

I definitely plan on doing another SYB trip, and if you’re looking for a fun group trip to go on- I recommend this company for sure!

reviews.name: Claire Hanrahan
reviews.text:
Don’t think just do - the vibe of the trip and I couldn’t agree more!
I had followed SYB on social media for a little while and after a call with their founder Mantas I booked my first SYB trip to Iceland. I wanted to see the real Iceland and not just drive to the typical tourist spots and that’s what exactly this trip allowed.
I was a little hesitant as I was coming from Australia, the furthest I had ever been from home and it was so cold. However once I met the crew I knew this was exactly where I should be.
Whilst I don’t surf, do much yoga or drink beer( love champagne and wine) I loved what this trip stood for which was we exercised hard but also partied hard! Everyone was there for a good time!
I had the most incredible leaders Bradford, Elena, Ken and Chuko who made sure this trip was an unforgettable experience and were always so warm and welcoming. It wouldn’t have been the same without them. The crew was also so much fun and we had a ball.
Not sure I can go back to Iceland now as I don’t think I’d ever be able to top this experience. So book that trip as you won’t regret it.
Claire (Australia)

Turkish Riviera ⛵️🇹🇷

What a week! We were so lucky to have Eli and Nikki as our SYB leaders. They were both amazing and honestly made the trip what it was.

Eli brought the  adventure every day — from hiking and watersports to jumping off the boat, exploring and plenty of laughs along the way. Nikki’s yoga and meditation sessions were the perfect balance and a great way to slow down after a big day.

They were both so easy-going, encouraging and genuinely fun to be around. Nothing ever felt forced and, because we were such a small group, it felt like we all became friends really quickly.

There were so many laughs, a lot of drinks, plenty of adventures and memories I’ll be talking about for a long time. I also loved watching the way they led the group — calm, inclusive, encouraging and always making everyone feel comfortable. Definitely some leadership qualities I’ll be taking home with me!

Couldn’t have asked for better leaders. Thanks for such an incredible week, Eli and Nikki — you guys were the best! ❤️🍾

reviews.name: Ashley Anderson
reviews.text:
This was my fourth Surf Yoga Beer trip, and it was hands down my best one yet. Türkiye and the Turkish Riviera were spectacular, but Nikki R. and Eli Elmore were what made this experience truly exceptional.

This was my second trip with Eli, and he is by far my favorite leader to travel with. He has an innate ability to lead with confidence while remaining thoughtful, approachable and deeply respectful of everyone around him. His conviction in the way he lives, his ability to bring people together and his willingness to extend grace when it is needed set him apart. He creates an environment where people feel supported, included and encouraged to become the best versions of themselves. Eli alone makes any experience ten times better, regardless of the destination, and I would travel anywhere with him as a leader.

Nikki brought an entirely different and equally valuable energy to the trip. She made everything more fun while also having a remarkable ability to make everyone feel comfortable being completely themselves. From creating TikTok music videos and laughing over the smallest things to having meaningful one-on-one conversations, she knew exactly when to bring the energy and when to slow down and genuinely connect.

Nikki was also one of the best yoga instructors I have ever practiced with. Meditation and journaling have always been difficult for me, but her guidance made both feel natural, accessible and meaningful. She leads with kindness, and that kindness speaks volumes. Nothing about her approach felt forced or performative. She created a safe space that allowed people to open up, reflect and participate at their own pace.

Together, Eli and Nikki created the perfect balance of adventure, structure, laughter, reflection and genuine connection. They made every person feel seen and brought out something special in the entire group. I would enthusiastically book another trip led by either of them and would be especially excited to travel with them together again.

This was more than an incredible vacation. It was a life changing experience, and Nikki and Eli were a huge reason why.

reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: SYB has the best active, group travel in the game! Just book it and go, they cover ALLLL the details. I recently traveled with them to Belize and it was amazing! Great, curated group of individuals and nice accommodations. Some highlights of the trip included the neon yoga, along with swimming with local nurse sharks. If you are seeking an active, action packed trip - look no further! 🌴

reviews.name: Ely Goldberg
reviews.text:
I have now been on two incredible Surf Yoga Beer trips and all I can say is wow! Just spent a week in Belize in December, and I’m still riding the high from it and have already booked my next trip. I’ve traveled a lot, but these trips feel different in the best way; more connected, more intentional, and honestly more fun than I expected. Both Belize and my NYE last year in Nicaragua were both 10/10!!

What stood out most wasn’t just the beautiful beaches or the balance of planned activities, but the people. On both trips the group energy was unreal. Everyone showed up open, supportive, and ready to make the most of every moment. By the end of the week, it felt like we’d known each other forever.

The leaders also deserve a huge shoutout, Mantas, Steph, Courtney, Sam, Eli, Duncan, Allison, Sav, Shriner and Matas and so many more across both trips. They set the tone from day one: warm, organized, and genuinely invested in making sure every single person had an amazing experience. They’re the kind of people who make you want to show up as your best self.

Every day had its own magic, whether it was sunrise workouts, exploring Caye Caulker, standing up on a surfboard for the first time ever, or laughing over dinner after a full day of adventure. And, of course, the big highlight each trip were the multiple boat days!!

If you’re thinking about booking a Surf Yoga Beer trip, just do it. The destinations are incredible, but it’s the community and the leadership that make it unforgettable. I left feeling inspired, recharged, and genuinely grateful for all the people I met.

reviews.name: Snover Punia
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer is INCREDIBLY thoughtfully put together. It is multifaceted combining fitness, mindfulness, and fun. It is inclusive of different fitness levels as well! The team leaders create an environment that artfully invokes connectedness and togetherness among solo travelers. I did the SYB Nicaragua trip this Thanksgiving holiday and did not for a second miss my family. It is a magical place that shuts out the stress of the work with the sound of waves crashing, breathtaking views, and vibrant greenery. All the elements of this trip have inspired me to leap out of my rut and I am so grateful for everyone I have met on this trip. Huge shout out to Mantas, Eli, and Jenny for bringing out the best in those around them!!

reviews.name: Jordan Jackson
reviews.text: Don't overthink, just book! This was my first solo group travel experience, and I'm so happy I went with Surf Yoga Beer. From the moment we exited the plane, the leaders were so welcoming. Each day was planned out in detail, so you can just sit back, or rather hike up, all the mountains and waterfalls, and enjoy all the beauty Iceland has to offer. The photographers were so talented, allowing you to detach from your phone and connect with nature and each other. Every activity had varying levels of fitness intensity, so if you aren't in peak shape, don't talk yourself out of this! The hostel was clean, comfortable, and the staff made us feel at home. But most importantly, the people you will meet takes this experience to another level. From the leaders to the Surf Yoga Beer vets to the first timers, everyone radiated positivity and inclusiveness. Even a month after being home, our Iceland group is still chatting away, meeting up for workouts, enjoying the occasional bev, and even planning future travel adventures. I am so grateful for the experience and if you have any hesitations, don't think, just book!

reviews.name: Coral Abreu
reviews.text: Iceland was my first trip with SYB and for sure wont be my last. Everything was planned and had backups, it was so easy to be at ease. Our Leader Bradford was incredible, specially how he made 40 strangers feel connected. Our photographers Eli and Bri did an amazing job capturing every moment. Every day was well balanced with a physical activity, mindfulness and of course some healthy fun. 1000% would recommend for any solo travel.

reviews.name: Monica Kim
reviews.text:
Surf (fitness)
Yoga (or pushups)
Beer (whenever you need to quench your thirst).

With so many different solo travel companies out there, this really appealed to me with the idea of having a good time while keeping your fitness levels at a priority. Also, I liked the idea of being surrounded by likeminded people as well as those close in age. I’ve experienced another solo travel company, and although I’ve enjoyed that experience, the age gap made it a little more difficult to connect with the other travelers.

There is a different type of camaraderie at SYB that allows you to connect and truly get to know the other travelers to build long term friendships. My initial expectation was just party and workout. However, some activities allow for some quiet time for self reflection and even personal growth in a beautiful and serene environment (Lux & Chill Turkey 2).

I can see why so many people do multiple trips with SYB, and I’ll be no different.
Thank you, Steph & Mantas 🫶

reviews.name: tim reichmann
reviews.text:
I had the best summer experiencing two amazing Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) trips. First I went to their Croatia trip with 45 other people - what a party and what a beautiful place! Then I spent two weeks on a gulet boat sailing the Turkish coast between Marmaris and Bodrum - a much more leisurely and luxe lifestyle with 9 other adventurers.

Highlights:

Croatia: lots of group workouts, big parties, boat day on a massive pirate ship, kayaking, crystal clear waters, the hotel has a lovely sauna and spa facility, I made so many new friends on this trip! Definitely a big trip for partying but also lots of good workouts and meditation and moments of connection with others.

Turkey: You're on a really deluxe boat the whole time. There is a chef who makes you the best multi-course turkish meals for 3 meals a day, the cabins have nice showers and AC, I slept out under the stars on the day-beds most nights just because I could, we swam in the sea multiple times a day, went water-skiing/wake boarding/jet skiing, did a bunch of hikes to points with stunning views of the Turkish coastline, went clubbing in Marmaris and Bodrum with 9 of my new best friends.

Lowlights:
Going back to work/school after such a magical 3 weeks. Can't wait to go on my next SYB trip - hopefully one of the ones to Nicaragua so I can get my surf on!

About the company: I learned about SYB through Instagram ads and wondered how the actual experience would compare to the ads... I have to say it delivered exactly what was advertised. The boat in the ads was the boat we were on, the people in the ads and the quality of those photos is what they deliver with their professional photographers taking pictures of everyone all day every day. Lastly, Mantas (the founder) and Steph as well as all the other staff are incredible people (and fitness coaches) and the culture they've inspired SYB adventurers to be part of is really special.

reviews.name: Kayla Guerin
reviews.text:
Traveling through Iceland with my new SYB friends was an unforgettable adventure! Exploring waterfalls, hiking up breathtaking mountains, running with amazing people, and soaking in hot springs was absolutely incredible. Each workout ended with a giant celebration, turning every accomplishment into a joyous festivity. It was the perfect blend of adventure and fun, making every moment memorable.

One of the most challenging parts of the trip ended up being one of my favorite memories. We ran through the rain and were battling 40mph winds. Yet, there I was, drenched and laughing, with the wind howling around us. It was wild, exhilarating, and somehow perfectly unforgettable....and the waterfall at the end of the run was BEAUTIFUL.

Bradford, Bri, and Eli led us with such enthusiasm and spirit; their guidance made every moment magical and exhilarating. It was truly the ultimate experience, filled with laughter and discovery.

I cannot say enough good things about Surf Yoga Beer.

reviews.name: Sarah Barr
reviews.text:
Wow, where do I begin?!?! I write this review nearly a week and a half after returning home from the #SYBIceland24 trip and I am still floating on Cloud Nine from this experience. If you are someone seeking connection, adventure and/or have a strong desire to travel, but haven't booked that trip for whatever reason, I strongly encourage you to keep reading, take a leap of faith and BOOK THE TRIP.

This was my first Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) trip and it did NOT disappoint. From the second I arrived at the airport, I felt a deep sense of community and connection (two soon-to-be friends saw me at baggage check and asked "Are you with SYB?"; we later synced up with others via our trip's WhatApp group chat) and those bonds only strengthened throughout the five-day trip. It sounds so corny, but it's true: 43 strangers from around the world arrived as solo travelers and we all left as friends.

Our fearless group leaders and photographers (s/o to Bradford, Eli and Bri!) created an incredibly safe and inclusive environment for the trip ("Don't think, just do!", be open minded to new experiences, approach all conversations with curiosity and respect, etc.), while flawlessly navigating all of the twists and turns that come with travel. Having everything planned out really helped me embrace the present moment, which was incredibly liberating. Not to mention, we went to THE COOLEST spots and have incredible photos to cherish for a lifetime.

I cannot recommend this experience enough. SYB was the experience of a lifetime and I'm so happy I booked the trip :)

reviews.name: Jessica Brantley
reviews.text:
Iceland has always been a bucket list location, so I signed up for Fire and Ice with SYB hoping to see some beautiful sites. Not only did I experience the most amazing views, but I also had the opportunity to meet incredible people that share my passion for adventure and traveling.

The trip leader Bradford has a unique talent of bringing people together from all different walks of life. I was traveling alone and am extremely introverted around large groups of people, but by the end of trip, I felt like I was surrounded by my closest friends.

The photographers Eli and Bri were equally amazing with their ability to connect with people both on and off camera. I continue to look back at the photos and videos to relive this magical experience.

My sincerest gratitude to the SYB family for making this a trip of lifetime! I can’t wait for the next one 💜

reviews.name: Christian Labertew
reviews.text: Guaranteed lifelong memories, forever friends and excellent vibes. Iceland 2024 took 40 strangers and within 30 minutes we were running and dancing in the rain together. Beyond grateful to the entire SYB team who welcomed everyone with open arms, and who take the time to put together a comprehensive itinerary so you have zero worries once you get there. It’s 11/10 worth it. Don’t overthink it, you will not regret traveling with SYB

reviews.name: Nick Lynk
reviews.text: Iceland was a fantastic experience with Surf Yoga Beer!  We had a great group and an epic itinerary.  Our leaders (Bradford, Eli, and Bri) were awesome!

reviews.name: Tori Bezoza
reviews.text: SYB Iceland trip was 10/10!!!! I went solo and left with 40 incredible connections. Bradford, Eli & Bri were our team leads and photographers and they brought the energy and made the trip even more incredible. Can’t recommend it enough, go book it!

reviews.name: Kacie DeMaio
reviews.text: I'm still on a high from SYB Iceland. It was such an incredible experience, and I'm so glad I took the plunge (literally and figuratively). I expected to see some jaw-dropping sights, and SYB did not disappoint. It felt like we accomplished 2 weeks worth of activities in 5 days. What I didn't expect was the bond I'd create with the other trip go-ers. Our fearless leader, Bradford, was a bright light the entire trip! He led us on incredible adventures each day, while fielding endless questions and adapting to the unpredictable weather (and lava!) in Iceland each day. Beyond that, he did it all with inspiring energy and a smile on his face 24/7. Our incredibly talented photographers, Eli and Bri, captured every second of the trip in the most beautiful way possible. Endlessly grateful for these three and the rest of our 40-person squad. Truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience (until my next SYB trip)!

reviews.name: Taylor Bell
reviews.text: My first Surf, Yoga, Beer trip provided a unique opportunity to make 40 new friends while exploring the beautiful country of Iceland. The leaders welcomed us with open arms from the minute we stepped off the plane. The plans and back up plans were thoughtfully organized to offer the perfect mixture of exercise and fun. It is truly such an incredible experience for a solo adventurer to be able to travel with such like-minded people. The positive energy and good vibes were infectious. I'm so grateful that I had the opportunity to be on this trip and look forward to all of the good times ahead with SYB!

reviews.name: Kyle Lowe
reviews.text: If you're looking for a way to make amazing connections with wonderful people all while exploring an exotic new country then Surf Yoga Beer is for you! Each day blends a combination of physical activity, mindfulness, and a lot of fun. The leaders of my trip to Iceland went above and beyond to create an environment where 40 strangers could come together over 6 days and leave as lifelong friends. I definitely plan to sign up for another! Hope to meet you there!

reviews.name: Allyson Mucha
reviews.text: I just finished my second trip with SYB. It’s a magical experience to be brought together with a group of people who are so like-minded uninterested in the same things you are. Exploring a new country always feel difficult alone as a girl with the leaders always make sure that you’re safe to go on vacation and not to be glued to your phone because someone is there to always take your picture. I’m not done yet. I can’t wait for the next one!

reviews.name: Patrick Jennings
reviews.text:
I just finished my first SYB trip to Croatia.

With yoga, early morning workouts, sunset pirate ship parties, ocean kayaking, historical exploration, cliff jumping and simply just getting to connect with cool people this trip has something for everyone.

From start to finish, Mantas and his elite team of leaders did a beautiful job making sure everyone had a great time and got to experience something unique.

If you’re hesitant about signing up, just do it. You wont regret it!

reviews.name: Alisa Pallitto
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer allowed me to experience what I honestly can refer to as the happiest week of my life. I went to SYB Amalfi this past June, stepping out of my comfort zone and going completely solo. This was my first experience solo traveling and Steph, Mantas, Molly, and Chuko, along with the 41 other group members made the experience one I will never forget. I can’t say enough good things about the positive environment that was created, one that allowed each and every person to feel welcome, loved, and appreciated. This is a travel group that emphasizes the importance of building meaningful relationships and I am so grateful to have gotten to experience that. I was already thinking about which SYB adventure would be next the second I got back home! I don’t have a single regret regarding this trip and would go back in a heartbeat; don’t think just do!

reviews.name: Lisette B
reviews.text: Having been on at least one trip a year over the past 5 years, I cannot be more grateful for SYB and to be part of the SYB family. Not only have I been to places I would have never been myself such as deserted islands in the Philippines or the mountains of Ireland, the sense of adventure and friendship on those trips unmatched! A week with SYB feels like a month on any other holiday, because they make sure you’ll be doing all the things. I made lifelong friends and every trip is more special than the last. Doing things out of your comfort zone is great for lifelong bonding with your new friends and feeling on top of the world after every trip. A special shoutout to all the leaders who bring all the energy to make sure you have the trip of lifetime. DON’T THINK JUST DO and book that trip!!!!

reviews.name: Brian Rokeach
reviews.text: DO IT!   Just got back from SYB Morocco and....IT...WAS....AMAZING!!  Truth be told I was ambivalent about signing up as I'm on the upper end of the demographic, I'm an avid traveler on my own and I was questioning the price point a bit so I wasn't sure this would be for me.   My concerns couldn't have been more unfounded.   There was a wide range of ages on the trip (not that it mattered). The food, accommodations and activities were incredible. And I left with such a sense of community, fulfillment and joy that I'm genuinely struggling to return to normal life which typically is not an issue for me.   I can't say enough about the entire experience, in particular our "leaders" Katie, Daryl, Sam and of course Alex.   They made an epic experience truly unforgettable.  If I had to say anything even remotely negative it's that this might not be the trip for someone looking to do a deep dive into the culture and history of a country. However if you're looking for an easy, safe and fun way to travel to places you've always wanted to go while meeting incredible fitness focused people with open hearts and minds, I highly encourage you to try one out. I will definitely be planning another SYB trip!

reviews.name: Savanna Cyr
reviews.text:
My trip to the Philippines with Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) stole my heart. It was my first solo trip and my first time to Asia. This company made me feel safe and welcome. The SYB staff encourages you to be yourself and live for adventure without fear. I enjoyed the connections I made, and the people I met became my friends. I do talk to most after the trip. For someone looking to step outside of their comfort zone, explore a new place, and connect with others and yourself, I encourage you to book a trip with Surf Yoga Beer. I've already done it!

Booking a trip with SYB was easy and accessible. The accommodations promised on the SYB website were presented, and all expectations outmatched reality. There is no travel stress on this trip; SYB takes care of you.

reviews.name: Christine Vegso
reviews.text: I had an amazing first trip with SYB. Everything was super easy from airport pickups to daily activities. Everything was already set up. Nicaragua was beautiful and Duncan and the SYB team made it even better. Awesome daily workouts and yoga sessions. It was amazing that we had a photographer capture it everything. Eli did an amazing job.

reviews.name: Sara Turnley
reviews.text: Thank you SYB for the memories, the friends, the adventures and all the fun!! It was such a treasure not only to experience the OG location, SYB Nicaragua 🤩 but it was so special to be able to watch my good friend Jillian be in her element and lead the trip with fun and passion. I walked in knowing two people, but walked out with 20 new friends and a whole lotta memories and for that I’ll forever be thankful. All the leaders on the trip were so much fun to be around and learn from. Crushed it Nica 2024! can’t wait for the next SYB adventure!! Where to next??

reviews.name: Kailey Gullett
reviews.text: I don't know where to begin. Thank you to Surf Yoga Beer for creating the best community, an experience of a lifetime, and pushing me to try new things. I went to Iceland 2022 and signed up solo not knowing anyone and leaving with a whole new SYB family/Squad. The vibes were immaculate: all the daylight, exploring, dancing, laughter, and smiling never stopped. I truly am so grateful for SYB creating this trip and giving me the best trip of my life. More trips are to come in the future. It is just the beginning! Why say no when you can say Yes!

reviews.name: Harim Jeong
reviews.text: SYB Amalfi was an experience that exceeded my expectations. The itinerary that’s so thoughtfully put together blends every aspect of travel that makes the week so fulfilling - themed parties with a dj, boat rides, challenging but non intimidating workouts, the best food with scenic views, and a group of people who simply know how to have a good time! If you’re on the fence just book a trip you won’t regret it.

reviews.name: Allyson Mucha
reviews.text: I just finished my first SYB trip to Nicaragua. The trip leaders were amazing and always available to talk to. SYB made it easy to relax and just take in what was going on around me. If you’re on the fence about signing up… don’t think just do, you won’t regret it. Can’t wait for the next one.

reviews.name: Sara Balaban
reviews.text: THE BEST. I’ve traveled with a ton of group travel companies before, but nothing compares to a trip with SYB. Besides the epic location and the logistics taken care of for you, there’s a level of connection and engagement I haven’t experienced with any other groups. Oh, and their trips include a professional photographer!

reviews.name: Anna Geyfman
reviews.text: If you’re looking for fun, adventure, fitness, community I highly recommend you book with SYB! Had the best time, made new friends, pushed myself physically & learned to surf! Left the Nicaragua trip & signed up for two more in 2024! The only downfal was our trip wasn’t long enough - we didn’t want it to end!

reviews.name: Ken Katz
reviews.text:
I did my first SYB trip to Iceland a few months ago.  I came in knowing no one but immediately felt part of the group.  35 people from around the world came together to hike, explore, hang out, and have a blast together.  The SYB group leaders were amazing, bringing everyone together and making everyone feel included.

The trip itself was a mix of hiking, running, and relaxing.  The places we were able to go were well beyond the standard Iceland trip and often felt like we were seeing just magical fantasy worlds.  From hot springs in the middle of nowhere to hiking up mountains to desolate waterfalls the scenery was unbelievable; but the group made the trip.  Not to be left out was a game of thrones costume themed workout.  I left feeling like I have friends in several countries and states who I can call whenever I am in town.

I've been on other group trips and felt this was the most welcoming group I've been with.  I am already planning next SYB trips and highly recommend checking out Iceland with them.
